meta.audience: designers and makers who need a portfolio today
meta.title: Frame
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from the app: source/README.md, its design tokens (src/index.css in the app repository) and its captured screens. A light grey studio, white panels with a chrome bezel, near-black type, one hot orange (#FF5A1F) and monospaced labels; the reel frames everything in orange viewfinder corners, as the name says.

source.notes: the fastest portfolio: editor left, live preview right, three templates, export as one self-contained HTML file
the real app (its production build, served locally) captured by capture/app.json; the portfolio of 이로아 and its six works are the app's own fictional sample data
Pretendard Variable (the app's face) and JetBrains Mono (labels); SIL OFL 1.1

rationale.palette: The app's tokens: studio grey #E6E7EA and #F5F5F6, white surfaces, ink #0B0B0D / #3F4047 / #62636B, and its hot orange #FF5A1F (the period in 'Frame.', the live dot, the selected template). The portfolio's own blue (#2B3BFF in the sample work) only appears inside the captured preview.
rationale.type: Pretendard Variable at 900 for the wordmark and headlines (the app sets '프로필', '내보내기' and the portfolio name heavy and tight); monospaced capitals for its labels ('PORTFOLIO BUILDER', 'ESTIMATED SIZE', 'GRID / EDITORIAL / MONO').
rationale.motion: Quick and exact, like framing a shot: orange viewfinder corners snap onto what matters, windows slide in on a spring with little overshoot, the preview changes the instant a letter is typed, template faces wipe one into the next on the beat. Holds keep a slow camera drift and a blinking live dot.
rationale.sound: Corporate in G major at 112 BPM (7 bars in 15 s, 14 in 30 s): warm piano and strings for a tidy, professional tool, with glassy SFX (key taps, a click on export, a pop as the file lands).
rationale.visuals: Four scenes in the 15 s cut: viewfinder corners frame the name; a name typed in the real editor appears letter by letter in the real live preview; the real export card (2.02 MB, HTML 1, 12 images, 0 external references) sends out one HTML file that opens as the finished portfolio; the end card. The 30 s cut adds the three templates of the same portfolio.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a short, muted launch reel with slogan-length Korean copy shown as type.
